title: Add compact invocation-digest-exporter and contextual alert suppressor
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: long-tail noisy alerts and expensive full-trace storage make SRE investigations slow and costly. This PR introduces a lightweight invocation-digest-exporter that captures a compact, fixed-size summary for every invocation (phase timing quantiles, token-cost estimate, KV-cache-hit-fingerprint, route tags) and a contextual alert-suppressor that uses digest scores and historical clustering to temporarily mute low-actionability alerts and reduce paging fatigue. Scope: implement exporter service (Go), streaming producer in the runtime, a consumer that writes digests to a compact index (time-series + Bloom-ish fingerprint store), a dashboard with digest sampling panels, an RBAC-safe toggle in the Console, unit + integration tests, and docs + runbook updates. Design notes: digests are intentionally lossy to bound storage and network overhead; we include a pluggable scorer for alert suppression so teams can tune aggressiveness per route; privacy: digests avoid user payloads and are pseudonymized before indexing. Testing: includes synthetic replay harness to validate retention/fidelity and an SLO test showing 42% reduction in alert noise in our staging traffic with negligible change to detection of actionable incidents. Rollout plan: feature-gated by runtime flag and Console toggle; staged canary (10% tenant sample) then 50% then global over two weeks; if digest fidelity regression is detected we automatically roll back to full traces. See linked Linear items and the on-call runbook section in docs. Checklist: [x] exporter service + proto, [x] runtime producer, [x] index consumer, [x] dashboard + Console toggle, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] docs + runbook, [x] staged rollout plan.

notes_on_rollback: Runtime feature flag allows immediate disable of digest emission; consumer supports a dry-run mode where digests are written to a staging index. Runbook includes an automated fidelity check that will flip the flag if false positives on detection exceed threshold.
perf_impact_summary: Emitter added ~0.8% CPU at p95 on 1k rps staging with digest size ~512 bytes; index writer tuned to batch 128 digests and emits ~30% fewer writes under bursty traffic compared to naive writes. Alert volume reduced by 42% in staging for sampled tenants.
privacy_considerations: Digests exclude request/response text and PII; user IDs are hashed with a rotating salt before indexing. Docs include data retention policy (30 days by default) and an opt-out procedure per tenant.
release_notes: New: Compact invocation digest exporter and adaptive alert suppressor. Benefits: reduced alert noise and cheaper long-tail analysis; opt-in via Console toggle and feature flag. No breaking changes for customers. See docs/observability/digests.md for configuration and runbook.
